name: Live notes
notes: Live notes during and after a call

features.feature: During a call with live notes on, the Transcript tab is the live transcript alone at full width, kept at its end; Now, Decisions, Action items and Open questions go into My notes, each with a time jump; the first after about 90 s

My notes' live box shows the call's model, the state (waiting, updating, updated N ago, failed, busy, signing in, paused, local, ended) and usage in one muted line under Now, and what to do about a sign-in or settings problem; its ⋯ menu holds the model for the call, Pause / Resume and Ask Claude about this call
After the call the live notes stay in My notes beside the final transcript (searchable, full width) and go into `transcript.md` as a "Live notes" draft
With live notes off a recording call says how to turn them on, and nothing is sent to a model
"Last time" (still to do, highlights) shows in My notes' live box during a recurring call; Ask Claude about this call (its ⋯ menu) opens the Claude panel

My notes is one timeline: Now pinned on top, then the user's notes (•, their kinds) and the live notes' items (✦, as ! decision, ☐ to-do with its owner, ? question) in time order — the user's never moved, a live item with no time last; live items are read-only and their chips jump to the transcript; answers follow under "Asked about this call"; with live notes off or none kept the panel is as without them

While a call records, live notes don't run on a profile whose model is on this computer (it would take the GPU from the call): `live show` says `local` from the start, nothing is sent, and Settings → AI says so next to "Live notes during calls" when the default profile is such a one. Claude and model servers on other computers still summarise

While a call records, the window draws only what changed: new transcript turns are added (the others stay as they are), the clock counts by itself, the recording dot pulses on the compositor (opacity)

On Claude (an account or Claude Code as configured), a recording's live notes are kept by one Claude Code session that loops on its own with two tools bound to the call (wait for new lines, update the notes: checked like any notes, action items as proposals); it starts with the recording, ends after it, and its text is never read
